resultText:
- `out/product.png`: a 1920×1080 Cycles render of a stylized compact camera on a round pedestal. The scene is lit by three area lights: a key light (front-left, warm), a fill light (front-right, dimmer and cool) and a rim light (behind and above). The rim light is fairly faint in the final render. The body and grip share one material set to `#D94F30`, and the small parts (lens, buttons, trim) are black or metal.
- `product_shot.py`: the Blender script that builds and renders the scene. Re-run it with `/opt/homebrew/bin/blender -b -P product_shot.py`.
